configuration.baseline: fresh, batch/ubatch256, FlashAttention off, full evidence, context4096, threads4, model read, no preparation cache
configuration.screening: One warmup group, then one frozen120 pass per variant. Use repeated finalist runs for latency claims.

clear_probe.purpose: Isolate dirty-only physical clearing from forced clearing of already-clean KV. Rust wrapper removal is not toggled.

screening_protocol: Eight variants × three model/projector pairs, original frozen 120 JPEGs and prompts. One warmup group, one 120-pass each. Recorded earlier fresh controls validated against their raw input/timing/runtime identities. Single pass timing is diagnostic only.
final_protocol: Live final binary fresh/full/no-cache versus --vision-preserving, both batch/ubatch256/FlashOff/context4096/threads4/read on the same RTX3080. Identical four-image HTTP payloads evaluated serially. One warmup group then three complete120-passes per mode; fresh-first Qwen/Smol, preserving-first Gemma. Loading excluded, time/image amortizes group completion.
clear_probe_protocol: Same final binary forced physical clearing L2S1_FORCE_KV_CLEAR=1 versus dirty-only clearing with env0; both fresh/full/no-cache. One120-pass after warmup per mode. This isolates physical clear skipping, not the earlier Rust wrapper removal.

limitations: Fresh batch1024 equality is scoped to these short prompts; it does not prove parity for long states or different image layouts.
Flash and parallel each independently change scores in this sample; effects inside optimized combination are not additive.
Preservingprofile never caches prior results, image embeddings or KV.
No speedup was established in the final paired measurements; report per-pass variability.
